sentences.en: The scramble for Africa was the last wave of colonialism.
sentences.zh: 1. 对非洲的瓜分是殖民主义的最后一波。

sentences.en: Scrambled eggs and bacon sound really good right about now.
sentences.zh: 2. 现在吃炒鸡蛋和培根听起来很不错。

sentences.en: "Do you prefer scrambled eggs?" "No, we prefer fried eggs."
sentences.zh: 3. “你喜欢炒鸡蛋吗？”“不，我们更喜欢煎蛋。”
